title: ACCEPT-AI-BC Patients´ acceptance of artificial intelligence in breast cancer tumor boards
summary: The study examines patients' acceptance of the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in tumor boards for breast cancer. The aim is to identify factors that influence the willingness to use AI in this context. The insight gained lies in identifying opportunities and potential concerns from the patient's perspective at an early stage, thereby promoting patient-centered care concepts in the field of oncology.

interventions.name: Tumor board without artificial intelligence support (immersive scenario)
Tumor board with artificial intelligence support (immersive scenario)
Tumor board with artificial intelligence as the main decision-maker (immersive scenario)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Minimum age ≥18 years
- Self-reported breast cancer (current or past)
- Sufficient knowledge of German to understand scenarios/items
- Access to the internet and use of the GDPR-compliant tool (Unipark)
Exclusion criteria:
- <18 years of age
- No (self-reported) breast cancer
- Insufficient German language skills to understand the questionnaire
- Extremely short processing time (speeding)
- Systematically identical answers (straightlining)
- High proportion of missing core items (e.g., >20% missing in the primary endpoint)
- Non-patients (e.g., relatives, professionals)
- Acute crisis/stress with indication of inability to participate (self-reported)
